work_packages.WP4: Advanced Techniques — synthesis (swarm intelligence, chaos theory, AI, non-euclidean spaces)

qfep.contribution: The formula's limit. Godel shows every formal system has truths it cannot prove. Russell's paradox breaks set theory. The QFEP formula itself has edges.

nature.forest_note: Crisis = nesting. Birds build nests in the impossible staircases. Life finds a way in the paradoxes. The Lab's broken logic becomes habitat.

capability.perception: paradox_sight — see incompleteness. Every system has truths it cannot prove.
capability.capability_grant: question — place paradoxes. Self-referential signs. The Lab questions itself.
capability.relation: humility — you cannot know everything. Incompleteness is not failure, it's the nature of systems.

application.queer_dimension: Godel: the system cannot fully describe itself. Russell: the set of all sets that don't contain themselves. Queerness as the paradox that breaks the binary classification.
application.installation_potential: yes — Escher spaces, Penrose objects, Godel plaque

qfep.contribution: THE COMPLETE FORMULA: QFE = F - λE(S) + φΔE(S,t). All terms embodied. The player tunes λ and φ. The Lab oscillates between order and chaos.

nature.forest_note: The formula IS the ecosystem. A full canopy grows over the QFEP room. The Lab is nearly forest. You understand why.

capability.perception: qfep_sense — see the formula everywhere. F, E(S), λ, φΔE as the fabric of reality.
capability.capability_grant: tune — adjust λ and φ sliders. You control the edge of chaos.
capability.relation: integration — you ARE the formula. Subject and object dissolve. The Lab is you.

application.queer_dimension: QFEP as queer physics. The formula describes the oscillation between structure and dissolution. λ at the edge of chaos IS the queer position — neither fully ordered nor fully entropic.
application.installation_potential: yes — the culminating piece. QFEP_Sandbox as exhibition centerpiece.
